title: Great pillows for the price
text: Great pillows for the price. These are great, and they feel comfortable and soft and look very clean just what I needed and for the price they are okay, may not be the best quality out there but they look ok so far I just hope they don't lose shape too fast.

product_metadata.title: Leeden 22 x 22 Pillow Inserts (Set of 2) - Throw Pillow Inserts with 100% Cotton Cover - 22 Inch Square Interior Sofa Pillow Inserts - Decorative Pillow Insert Pair - White Couch Pillow
features: 22 x22 PILLOW INSERT:The package includes 2 pack 22x 22 inch decorative pillow insert with cotton cover.
MULTIUSE: This set of two square pillows can be used as a sofa pillow, chair pillow, bed pillow, etc. You can insert it into pillowcases of various styles you like and decorate your room.

HIGH QUALITY: Our pillow inserts are made with a 100% cotton cover and sufficient 3D high-quality fillings. So it is breathable and skin-friendly and can give you enough support when you lie down and lean on.
EASY CARE: Made so they are easy to clean , our pillow inserts can be washed by hand or machine wash in gentle cycle and tumble dry on low heat.

EASY USE: They will be shipped vacuum packaged and will take up to a couple of hours to fully fluff up. The hidden zipper makes it easy to remove or add fillings. For fullness, buy one size larger than the pillowcases.
